item strings.or: A hand-made explosive. Not very refined, but it gets the job done.
item strings.tr: 手工制作的爆炸物。不太精致，但能完成任务。

item strings.or: It's like grass, but it's not from any plant.
item strings.tr: 它看起来像草，但是不来自于任何植物。

item strings.or: A trusty hammer. No ammo needed.
From the heaven, but it contains darkness.
item strings.tr: 来自天堂，但其中蕴含着黑暗。

item strings.or: A high-tech laser rifle. Fires laser charges.
item strings.tr: 高科技激光步枪。发射激光电池。

item strings.or: A charged cell that powers the laser.
item strings.tr: 为激光枪供能的充能电池。

item strings.or: A sharp blade that lets you dash and swing. It never wears out.
item strings.tr: 锋利的刀刃，可以突进与挥砍。永不磨损。

item strings.or: A simple pistol. Fires pistol bullets.
item strings.tr: 简单的手枪。发射手枪子弹。

item strings.or: A sturdy shotgun. Fires shotgun shells.
item strings.tr: 坚固的霰弹枪。发射霰弹壳。

item strings.or: A shell loaded with pellets for the shotgun.
item strings.tr: 装满弹丸的霰弹枪弹药。

item strings.or: A sharp sword that cuts harder than the hammer. No ammo needed.
item strings.tr: 一把锋利的剑，挥砍比锤子更有力。无需弹药。

item strings.or: A dull grey rock flecked with iron.
item strings.tr: 一块带有铁斑的灰色石头。

item strings.or: Smelted iron, ready to be worked.
item strings.tr: 冶炼好的铁，可以加工了。

item strings.or: An addon-namespaced alloy, proving that two content packs can coexist.
item strings.tr: 附加包命名空间的合金，证明两个内容包可以共存。

item strings.or: A dense round. Hits harder, but travels slower.
item strings.tr: 沉重的弹头。威力更大，但速度更慢。

item strings.or: A single heavy slug instead of a spread of pellets.
item strings.tr: 单发重弹头，取代一片散弹。

item strings.or: A pale metal vein, cold to the touch.
item strings.tr: 苍白的金属矿脉，触手冰凉。

item strings.or: Fossil resin that hums with old, stored motion.
item strings.tr: 树脂化石，低鸣着被封存已久的律动。

item strings.or: Refined silver, bright enough to ward off the dark.
item strings.tr: 精炼的银，明亮得足以驱散黑暗。

item strings.or: A silver charm that steadies the heartbeat. Worn in an accessory slot.
item strings.tr: 稳住心跳的银质护符。装备于配饰栏。

item strings.or: An amber lens that lengthens every shot. Worn in an accessory slot.
item strings.tr: 拉长每次射击距离的琥珀镜片。装备于配饰栏。

item strings.or: Amber and grass spun into a light step. Worn in an accessory slot.
item strings.tr: 琥珀与草叶编织出的轻盈脚步。装备于配饰栏。

item strings.or: A steel-caged heart that refuses to stop. Worn in an accessory slot.
item strings.tr: 囚于钢笼之中、拒绝停歇的心脏。装备于配饰栏。

item strings.or: A ground silver lens that stretches the reach of every weapon. Worn in an accessory slot.
item strings.tr: 打磨过的银镜，延展所有武器的射程。装备于配饰栏。

item strings.or: A storm caught in steel and amber. Worn in an accessory slot.
item strings.tr: 被封入钢铁与琥珀中的风暴。装备于配饰栏。

item strings.or: A laser tripod drill. Place it, then hold the scoreboard beside it to bore up to 10 tiles into the rock. Each pass chips 1 hardness.
item strings.tr: 激光三脚钻。放置后站在旁边按住计分板，可向岩层钻探 10 格，每次钻探削去 1 点硬度。

item strings.or: A reinforced laser tripod. Reaches 20 tiles into the rock and chips 3 hardness per pass.
item strings.tr: 加固的激光三脚钻。可向岩层钻探 20 格，每次钻探削去 3 点硬度。

item strings.or: A drill carrying a sliver of heaven. Its beam reaches 30 tiles and chips 9 hardness per pass.
item strings.tr: 带着一线天堂之力的钻头。光束可延伸 30 格，每次钻探削去 9 点硬度。

item strings.or: A laser-sealed jar with a health pickup floating inside. When its owner comes close it drops the pickup to the ground.
item strings.tr: 一只以激光封口的罐子，里面悬着一枚生命拾取物。主人靠近时，它会将拾取物掉到地上。

item strings.or: A placeable fire. Its embers burn nearby monsters but never players.
item strings.tr: 可放置的营火。火星会灼烧附近的怪物，但不会伤到玩家。

item strings.or: A heavy flame projector that fires a wide, searing burst. Feed it fuel canisters.
item strings.tr: 重型火焰喷射器，能喷出宽而炽烈的火团。需要消耗燃料罐。

item strings.or: Sprays a short cone of burning embers. Feed it fuel canisters.
item strings.tr: 喷射出短距离的燃烧余烬。需要消耗燃料罐。

item strings.or: Volatile fuel for the flamethrower and the flame cannon.
item strings.tr: 供火焰喷射器和火焰炮使用的不稳定燃料。

server strings.or: Account created. You are now logged in.
server strings.tr: 账号创建成功，你已登录。

server strings.or: You are not logged in. Use /login <username> <password> or /register <username> <password> to join the game.
server strings.tr: 你尚未登录。请使用 /login <用户名> <密码> 或 /register <用户名> <密码> 加入游戏。

server strings.or: You must be logged in to join the game. Use /login <username> <password>.
server strings.tr: 你必须登录才能加入游戏。请使用 /login <用户名> <密码>。

server strings.or: You do not have this item.
You need to be in the game to drop items.
server strings.tr: 你需要进入游戏才能丢弃物品。

server strings.or: You start to forget how to craft some things.
server strings.tr: 你开始忘记一些东西的制作方法。

server strings.or: You can no longer tell what many of your belongings are.
server strings.tr: 你已经想不起许多东西是什么了。

server strings.or: You forget who you are entirely.
server strings.tr: 你彻底忘记了自己是谁。

server strings.or: Click a recipe to see how to craft it. Tools are not consumed.
server strings.tr: 点击合成表查看制作方法。工具不会被消耗。

server strings.or: You can't remember any crafting recipes.
server strings.tr: 你想不起任何制作配方。

server strings.or: You can't remember what this is.
Use a number as the vote reason to drop that many.
server strings.tr: 在投票理由里填数字可一次丢弃多个。

server strings.or: Use a number as the vote reason to use that many.
server strings.tr: 在投票理由里填数字可一次使用多个。

server strings.or: Select an item to place on this slot.
server strings.tr: 选择要放入此槽位的物品。

server strings.or: Select an accessory to wear on this slot.
server strings.tr: 选择要装备到此栏位的配饰。

server strings.or: If you don't want to close menu when you use a option,
server strings.tr: 如果你不想在使用选项时关闭菜单，

server strings.tr: 那么你可以在控制台输入：
这里没有任何服务器投票

server strings.or: You do not have that many.
You cannot buy your own listing.
server strings.tr: 你不能购买自己的挂单。

server strings.or: The seller has no inventory space.
You must be near the merchant.
server strings.tr: 你必须靠近商人才能交易。

server strings.or: Click a merchant to see their goods.
Click the item you want to sell.
How many do you want to sell?
Type the amount in the vote reason box, then click Confirm.
server strings.tr: 在投票理由框里输入数量，然后点击确认。

server strings.or: Type the price in G in the vote reason box, then click Confirm.
server strings.tr: 在投票理由框里输入价格（G），然后点击确认。

server strings.or: Enter a positive whole amount of G.
server strings.tr: 请输入一个正整数金额（G）。

server strings.or: Payment: {}. Type the amount in the vote reason box, then click Confirm.
server strings.tr: 报酬：{}。在投票理由框里输入数量，然后点击确认。

server strings.or: Click one of your listings to take it down.
server strings.tr: 点击你的挂单将其下架。

server strings.or: Clean cloth wrapped over a wound. Mends a little health without clouding the mind.
server strings.tr: 包扎伤口的干净布条。恢复少量生命，且不会令头脑昏沉。

server strings.or: A field kit with everything needed to patch a tee up completely.
server strings.tr: 一套战地医疗包，能将 tee 完全治愈。

server strings.or: A bitter brew that clears the head and mends a scratch or two.
server strings.tr: 苦涩的药汤，能清醒头脑并治愈些许擦伤。

server strings.or: Hold the scoreboard next to it to control the drill. Jump to exit.
server strings.tr: 站在旁边按住计分板即可控制钻头，跳跃退出。

server strings.or: You have to be alive to place a drill.
server strings.tr: 你必须活着才能放置钻头。

server strings.or: Stand on the ground to place a drill.
server strings.tr: 请站在地面上放置钻头。

server strings.or: There is already a drill here.
server strings.tr: 这里已经有一个钻头了。

server strings.or: The drill could not be placed.
Drill placed. Hold the scoreboard next to it to take control; jump to let go.
server strings.tr: 钻头已放置。站在旁边按住计分板即可控制，跳跃退出。

server strings.or: Drill engaged. Aim with the cursor, hold fire to bore, jump to let go.
server strings.tr: 已接入钻头。用准星瞄准，按住开火开始钻探，跳跃退出。

server strings.or: Unknown language. Use /lang to list available languages.
server strings.tr: 未知语言。使用 /lang 查看可用语言。

server strings.or: Is switching worlds taking too long? Try Teeworlds: Archive!
server strings.tr: 觉得世界切入太慢？试试Teeworlds: Archive！

server strings.or: Did you know? You don't. Neither do I.
server strings.tr: 你知道么？你不知道。我也不知道。

server strings.or: Hover the cursor over a resource to see how much is left.
server strings.tr: 把准星移到资源上，就能看到它还剩多少。

server strings.or: Hold the scoreboard next to a drill to control it. Jump to let go.
server strings.tr: 站在钻头旁按住计分板即可控制它，跳跃即可松开。

server strings.or: Log in with /login or /register to keep your progress.
server strings.tr: 使用 /login 或 /register 登录，才能保存你的进度。

server strings.or: Cross the edge of a world to reach the next ring.
server strings.tr: 穿过世界边缘，就能进入相邻的环。

server strings.or: The menu shows what you can craft and what it needs.
server strings.tr: 菜单里能查看你可以制作什么，以及需要哪些材料。
出行（请站在火车入口上）

server strings.or: You must stand on a train entrance to travel.
server strings.tr: 你必须站在火车入口上才能出行。
当前没有可乘火车抵达的世界。

server strings.or: The train is still being prepared. Try again in a moment.
server strings.tr: 火车正在准备中，请稍后再试。

server strings.or: You have to be alive to place a health jar.
server strings.tr: 你必须活着才能放置生命罐。

server strings.or: Stand on the ground to place a health jar.
server strings.tr: 站在地面上才能放置生命罐。

server strings.or: There is no floor below the jar.
server strings.tr: 罐子下方没有可以放置的地面。

server strings.or: There is no room for a health jar here.
server strings.tr: 这里没有足够空间放置生命罐。

server strings.or: There is already a health jar here.
server strings.tr: 这里已经有一个生命罐了。

server strings.or: Health jar placed. Its owner coming close makes it drop a health pickup.
server strings.tr: 生命罐已放置。主人靠近时，它会掉出一枚生命拾取物。

server strings.or: Its owner standing close makes it drop a health pickup.
server strings.tr: 主人站在附近时，它会掉出一枚生命拾取物。
请先用准星对准一个容器。
请先用准星对准一个容器。

server strings.or: Click a container slot to take its stack back.
server strings.tr: 点击容器栏位可取回整堆物品。

server strings.or: Click one of your items to store it.
server strings.tr: 点击你的物品即可存入。

server strings.or: Use a number as the vote reason to move that many.
server strings.tr: 在投票理由里填数字可一次移动多个。

server strings.or: Aim at a container in a ruin and open the menu to store your goods.
server strings.tr: 在废墟中瞄准容器并打开菜单，就能存放你的物资。

server strings.or: A still-warm gland from a burrowing horror. Alchemists pay well for it.
server strings.tr: 来自钻地怪物的温热腺体。炼金师愿意出高价。

server strings.or: A humming shard of something that should not still be alive.
server strings.tr: 一块仍在嗡鸣的碎片，本不该还活着。
又一颗脑袋可以堆上了。

server strings.or: Run, and I will make it quick!
server strings.tr: 跑吧，我会让你死得痛快点！

server strings.or: The road is long, and I am in no hurry.
So this is where the road ends...
The clinic is open. Try not to bleed on the floor.
server strings.tr: 诊所开门了。别把血滴在地板上。

server strings.or: You look half-dead, {player}. I can fix that.
server strings.tr: 你看起来半死不活，{player}。我能治。

server strings.or: Bandages, tonics, medkits. All honest goods.
server strings.tr: 绷带、补剂、医疗包，都是实在货。

server strings.or: I will be back. I always am.
server strings.tr: 我会回来的，我一直都会。

server strings.or: The forge is hot. Say your piece.
Keep your hands where I can see them.
server strings.tr: 手放在我看得见的地方。
当前没有可乘火车抵达的世界。

server strings.or: That train destination is no longer available.
server strings.tr: 该火车目的地已不可用。

server strings.or: Aim at a building you own first.
server strings.tr: 请先瞄准你自己拥有的建筑。

server strings.or: Only the owner can change this building's lock.
server strings.tr: 只有建筑所有者能修改建筑锁。

server strings.or: Playing as a guest. Use /register <username> <password> to keep your progress on an account.
server strings.tr: 你正在以访客身份游玩。使用 /register <用户名> <密码> 可将进度保存到账号。

server strings.or: You are not in a team.
Teams are invitation-only. Ask a team leader to invite you.
server strings.tr: 队伍仅限邀请加入，请联系队长邀请你。
创建队伍（理由框填写名字）

server strings.or: No online player is available to invite.
server strings.tr: 当前没有可邀请的在线玩家。

server strings.or: No team has an online member right now.
server strings.tr: 目前没有队伍有在线成员。

server strings.or: You have no player identity yet.
You are already in a team. Leave it first.
server strings.tr: 你已经在一个队伍中，请先离开。

server strings.or: That team name is not usable.
That team name is already taken.
Only the leader can invite players.
server strings.tr: 只有队长可以邀请玩家。

server strings.or: You are already on the team.
That player has no player identity yet.
server strings.tr: 该玩家还没有玩家身份。

server strings.or: That player is already in a team.
server strings.tr: 该玩家已经在一个队伍中。

server strings.or: That player already has a pending invitation.
server strings.tr: 该玩家已有待处理的邀请。

server strings.or: {} invited you to join team {}. Open the Team menu to accept or decline.
server strings.tr: {} 邀请你加入队伍 {}，请打开队伍菜单接受或拒绝。

server strings.or: Only the leader can cancel an invitation.
server strings.tr: 只有队长可以取消邀请。

server strings.or: That player has no pending invitation.
server strings.tr: 该玩家没有待处理的邀请。

server strings.or: The invitation to team {} was withdrawn.
server strings.tr: 加入队伍 {} 的邀请已被撤回。

server strings.or: You have no pending team invitation.
server strings.tr: 你没有待处理的队伍邀请。
{} 拒绝了加入队伍 {} 的邀请。

server strings.or: You are not in a team.
Only the leader can kick members.
That player is not on your team.
server strings.tr: 该玩家不在你的队伍中。

server strings.or: Only the leader can change friendly fire.
server strings.tr: 只有队长可以修改友伤设置。

server strings.or: Only the leader can disband the team.
server strings.tr: 只有队长可以解散队伍。

server strings.or: The team was disbanded because the leader left.
server strings.tr: 队长已离开，队伍已解散。

server strings.or: No online player has that name.
server strings.tr: 没有该名字的在线玩家。

server strings.or: Several players have that name. Use the Team menu to pick one.
server strings.tr: 有多名玩家使用该名字，请使用队伍菜单选择。

server strings.or: Usage: /team create <name>, /team invite <player>, /team accept, /team decline, /team leave, /team disband, /team ff on|off
server strings.tr: 用法：/team create <名字>、/team invite <玩家>、/team accept、/team decline、/team leave、/team disband、/team ff on|off

server strings.or: A cold sigil torn from a sanctum guardian. Wearing it hardens the body.
server strings.tr: 从圣所守卫身上撕下的冰冷徽记。佩戴后身体会更坚韧。

server strings.or: You carry the smell of the surface. It will not save you.
server strings.tr: 你身上有地表的气味。那救不了你。

server strings.or: Campfire placed. It burns nearby monsters.
server strings.tr: 营火已放置。它会灼烧附近的怪物。

server strings.or: Stand on the ground to place a campfire.
server strings.tr: 请站在地面上放置营火。

server strings.or: There is already a campfire here.
server strings.tr: 这里已经有一个营火了。

server strings.or: There is no floor below the campfire.
There is no room for a campfire here.
server strings.tr: 这里没有空间放置营火。

server strings.or: You have to be alive to place a campfire.
server strings.tr: 你必须活着才能放置营火。

server strings.or: Campfires burn nearby monsters. Flame weapons need fuel canisters.
server strings.tr: 营火会灼烧附近的怪物。火焰武器需要燃料罐。

server strings.or: Move with A and D, jump with space, and use the mouse to hook and shoot. Type /help at any time to open this page.
server strings.tr: 用 A/D 移动，空格跳跃，鼠标钩爪和射击。随时输入 /help 打开本页。

server strings.or: Type /register <username> <password> in chat. Use /login <username> <password> to restore the same account on another day.
server strings.tr: 在聊天框输入 /register <用户名> <密码> 注册。之后用 /login <用户名> <密码> 找回同一账号。

server strings.or: Type /register <username> <password> to keep your progress; /login restores it.
server strings.tr: 输入 /register <用户名> <密码> 保存进度；用 /login 恢复。

server strings.or: Open the vote menu to reach Inventory, Craft, Loadout, Shop, Team, Language and this guide.
server strings.tr: 打开投票菜单可进入背包、制作、装备、商店、队伍、语言和本指引。

server strings.or: Aim at a resource and hold the scoreboard key to drill. Craft tools and weapons from the Craft page.
server strings.tr: 瞄准资源并按住记分板键开采。在制作页合成工具和武器。

server strings.or: Stand near a crate, chest or vault, aim at it and open Container. Click a slot to take items, or an inventory item to store it.
server strings.tr: 靠近木箱、宝箱或保险库，瞄准后打开容器菜单。点击容器格子取出物品，点击背包物品存入。

server strings.or: Stand on a train platform and open the menu. Pick a destination under Travel. You stay invincible for ten seconds after arrival.
server strings.tr: 站在火车平台上打开菜单，在旅行中选择目的地。到达后有十秒无敌时间。

server strings.or: Aim at a drill or building you own to change its lock on the main page.
server strings.tr: 瞄准你拥有的钻机或建筑，可在主菜单更改锁定权限。

server strings.or: Welcome to LastDay! This is a survival world: explore, gather, craft and keep moving.
server strings.tr: 欢迎来到 LastDay！这是一个生存世界：探索、采集、制作，并保持移动。

server strings.or: Move with A and D, jump with space, and use the mouse to hook and shoot.
server strings.tr: 用 A/D 移动，空格跳跃，鼠标钩爪和射击。

server strings.or: Open the vote menu for Inventory, Craft, Loadout, Shop, Team and the New Player Guide.
server strings.tr: 打开投票菜单可使用背包、制作、装备、商店、队伍和新手指引。

server strings.or: New here? Type /help for a short guide, or open the New Player Guide in the menu.
server strings.tr: 新来的？输入 /help 查看简短指引，或在菜单中打开新手指引。
